proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: condition (1) (U -> M equalizes s, t) makes h_U -> h_M factor through the quotient sheaf U/R by its coequalizer universal property; condition (2) makes the factor U/R -> h_M surjective; condition (3) makes it injective, since two sections of U/R agreeing in h_M lift locally to a pair in U x_M U, which by condition (3) lifts locally to R, i.e. the two sections are identified; a bijective map of sheaves is an isomorphism, so M represents U/R (source lines 3995-4000)

standard_prerequisites.name: Definition definition-quotient-sheaf (canonical tag 02VG)
standard_prerequisites.use: U/R is the tau-sheaf quotient; its universal property gives the factorization.

core_obligations: Factorization (proof line 3996): condition (1) says h_U -> h_M equalizes s and t, hence factors through U/R by the quotient sheaf's universal property.
Surjectivity (proof line 3997): condition (2) says exactly that U/R -> h_M is surjective as a map of sheaves.

Injectivity and conclusion (proof lines 3998-3999): condition (3) gives injectivity — two sections of U/R with equal image in h_M agree locally in M, lift locally to (a, b) in U x_M U, and condition (3) lifts (a, b) locally to R, identifying the sections; bijective hence isomorphic, so M represents U/R.
proof_roadmap: Factor h_U -> h_M through U/R (proof line 3996).
Read injectivity from condition (3) and conclude the representation (proof lines 3998-3999).
